alt: Five types of white blood cells (leukocytes). Granulocytes: neutrophil (3-5 lobed, dominant), eosinophil (bilobed, red granules), basophil (dark granules). Agranulocytes: lymphocyte (large round nucleus), monocyte (kidney-bean nucleus → macrophage in tissue). (Blausen Medical CC BY 3.0)
